lines.text: Nature can be beautiful and fascinating but scary at the same time. A natural disaster is an
unforeseen and sudden occurrence of an event resulting from natural processes of the Earth.
They can not be predicted nor avoided. Earthquake, tsunamis, volcanic eruption, cyclones,
floods, droughts, landslides and forest fires are all forms of natural disasters. Natural disasters
